A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same C-TeC research work and contain complete, readable main texts and Appendices A–M. Text comparison and rendered-page checks support a reliable comparison of equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original exploration experiments in robotic environments, Crafter and Craftax-Classic, together with appendix ablations, noisy-TV experiments and toy-MDP simulations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including state-coverage comparisons, achievement curves and the appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain identical encoders, contrastive training, intrinsic reward construction and SAC/PPO updates. The appendix implementation variants are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same robotic navigation and manipulation environments, Crafter, Craftax-Classic, noisy-TV Xland-Minigrid and toy MDPs. No task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: ETD, RND, ICM, APT, E3B, random policies and the Stadie et al. model-based baseline retain their respective experimental comparisons. Newly cited BYOL-Explore is not added as an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model configurations, state-coverage and achievement metrics, sampling procedures and experimental controls are unchanged in Section 6 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The sample-efficiency, representation-collapse and prior-knowledge studies remain identical, as do the ablations in Appendix G, noisy-TV test in H, toy-MDP analyses in J–K and behavioral examples in M.

E5.justification: Section 6.2 and Appendix D retain the same five-seed, mean-and-standard-deviation reporting. Uncertainty bands, tabulated uncertainty and other statistical reporting are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted curves, rankings and qualitative findings are identical, including the sample-efficiency results in Table 1 and C-TeC versus MBRL results in Table 8. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The occupancy definitions, contrastive objectives, information-theoretic derivations and Appendix J.1 fixed-point stability analysis are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, reasoning or proofs are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about temporal representations enabling intrinsic exploration, complex behavior and strong state coverage without quasimetric learning or episodic memory.

C2.justification: The reward interpretations, explanations of differences from ETD, qualifications on the theoretical analysis and stated future-work boundaries remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement and Appendices E–F retain identical code-access information, architectures, hyperparameters, implementation details, hardware descriptions and training-time estimates.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Guo et al. (2022), BYOL-Explore: Exploration by Bootstrapped Prediction, to the prediction-error exploration citations and adds its bibliography entry. No further discussion or revision of novelty positioning accompanies this limited addition.

P1.justification: Textual edits are limited to the citation/reference insertion and the updated arXiv version/date marking. Existing prose, terminology, explanations and section ordering remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The citation slightly changes line wrapping in Section 2, and the new reference reflows bibliography entries across pages 11–14. All figures, tables, captions and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 slightly broadens attribution by citing BYOL-Explore, but adds no discussion that changes the paper's argument or positioning. The methods, evidence, theoretical analysis, reproducibility information and complete appendices are unchanged; the bibliographic addition and local reflow do not meaningfully alter overall quality.
